headline: Oilers' Trade For Vasily Podkolzin Continues To Work Wonders With Breakout Season
take:
The Hockey News reports that Edmonton's offseason trade for Vasily Podkolzin, who came over from Vancouver, continues to look like the right call because of his breakout season.

Our numbers back the early results, though not all of them. Podkolzin has 7 goals and 12 points in 11 games so far this season, and he's played 18.91 minutes a night. Expected goals, which measure the quality of a player's chances, put him at 4.95, so he's scoring about 2 goals above what those chances suggest. Some of that will cool off. What looks sturdier is the play at 5-on-5, where EDM controls 58 percent of the expected goals with him on the ice, and the team's share is 15 points better when he plays. Last season he had 19 goals in 82 games, so the jump in output is real, even if the finishing is running hot. For EDM (8-2-1), he's helping a team whose 5-on-5 share is only 49 percent overall. VAN, which let him go, sits at 2-9-1.
